name: WFUcore Checkout Subscribe
author: devpixels

sections.description:
WFUcore Checkout Subscribe connects WooCommerce checkout directly to Flodesk, allowing customers to join your email list during checkout while automatically sending valuable order data to Flodesk custom fields.

Instead of collecting only an email address, the plugin enriches subscriber profiles with information from the customer’s order, making it easier to create targeted Flodesk segments and personalized email campaigns.

When a customer opts in during checkout, the plugin can send data such as:

  • Email address
  • Customer name
  • Purchased product
  • Product category
  • Order total value
  • Payment method
  • Billing country

This data can be mapped to Flodesk custom fields and used to build more relevant audience segments based on customer purchase behavior.

To improve reliability, subscribers are stored locally in WordPress before being sent to Flodesk. If an API request fails, subscriber records remain available for manual re-sync, helping prevent data loss.

The plugin also includes CSV export functionality, subscriber management tools, and consent-based subscription collection designed to work alongside WooCommerce checkout.

All features are included in the free version with no paid upgrades or Pro add-ons required.

This plugin is independently developed and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially associated with Flodesk or WooCommerce. Flodesk is a trademark of its respective owner.

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with Flodesk (https://flodesk.com), a third-party email marketing service.

When a user opts in during checkout, the plugin sends data to Flodesk in order to create or update a subscriber.

The data sent to Flodesk may include:
– Email address (required)
– Full name (if provided)
– Order-related metadata (custom fields)

No data is sent without explicit user consent via the checkout opt-in checkbox.

This data is used only for email marketing and segmentation purposes inside Flodesk.

For more information, please see Flodesk Privacy Policy:
https://flodesk.com/legal/privacy-policy

Features

All functionality is included in the free version with no paid upgrade required.

  • Newsletter opt-in checkbox at WooCommerce checkout
  • Automatic subscriber capture during checkout
  • Direct sync with Flodesk API
  • Support for custom fields in Flodesk
  • Automatically populate Flodesk custom fields using WooCommerce checkout data: * Product purchased, Product category purchased, Order total, Payment method, Billing country
  • Local subscriber storage in WordPress database
  • Manual sync for failed or pending subscribers
  • CSV export of subscriber data
  • Bulk and individual subscriber management
  • Lightweight admin interface
  • GDPR-friendly consent tracking

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via WordPress Admin
  3. Go to WFUcore Sync in the admin menu
  4. Add your Flodesk API key
  5. Configure the custom fields you want to send to Flodesk

For Instalation and Configuration Guide visit https://wfucore.com/woocommerce-flodesk-integration-guide.html
sections.faq:
Where do I enter my Flodesk API key?

In the WFUcore Sync dashboard page inside API Configuration box.

What data is sent to Flodesk?

The plugin sends enriched checkout data including:

  • Email address
  • Full name (if provided)
  • Primary purchased product
  • Product category
  • Order total value
  • Payment method used
  • Billing country

All data is sent only when the user explicitly opts in at checkout.

Can I export subscribers?

Yes. You can export all stored subscribers as CSV from the admin panel.

What happens if Flodesk API fails?

Subscribers are stored locally and can be manually synced later using the retry sync function.

Does this plugin track users outside checkout?

No. Data is collected only at checkout subscription opt-in.
